cases.name: CHK-005: no anonymous virtual nodes in trace
cases.execute: const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/profiler.js"); const handle = await m.startProfiler(); const fn = async()=>{let s=0;for(let i=0;i<1000;i++)s+=i;return s;}; await fn(); const trace = await handle.stop(); function hasAnon(nodes){for(const n of nodes){if(n.fn==="(anonymous)"&&n.file==="")return true;if(n.children&&hasAnon(n.children))return true;}return false;} return !hasAnon(trace)

cases.name: CHK-005: multi-child promoted not wrapped
cases.execute: const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/profiler.js"); const h = await m.startProfiler(); function a(){let s=0;for(let i=0;i<100;i++)s+=i;return s;} function b(){return a()+1;} a(); b(); const trace = await h.stop(); function findAnon(nodes){for(const n of nodes){if(n.fn==='(anonymous)'&&n.file==='')return true;if(n.children&&findAnon(n.children))return true;}return false;} return !findAnon(trace)

cases.name: CHK-005: zero project children returns null path
cases.execute: const m = await import("file:///" + $root.replace(/\\\\/g,"/") + "/packages/main/dist/tasks/profiler.js"); const h = await m.startProfiler(); await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,10)); const trace = await h.stop(); function countAnon(nodes){let c=0;for(const n of nodes){if(n.fn==='(anonymous)'&&n.file==='')c++;if(n.children)c+=countAnon(n.children);}return c;} return countAnon(trace)===0
